about_the_game:
Play as a city witch on a journey of battles and truth.

Wicked Little Witch is a story-driven, survivor-like action roguelite. You play as an amnesiac witch returning to the enchanted forest to search for your sister, face former friends, and uncover the truth behind your past, your powers, and your fate.

Included in the demo:

· Opening story chapter

· 3 playable characters (2 unlockable through gameplay)

· 1 grassland map

· Various regular enemies, 8 mini-bosses, and 2 story bosses

· 2 collectible and upgradable magic spells

Not included in the demo:

· Full story progression

· Support for more languages

· At least 15 unlockable characters in the full version

· 4 unique maps with different environments

· More enemy types and mini-bosses, 14+ story bosses

· 14+ unlockable magic spells

· Character upgrade system and enhancement shop

· Collection system (track unlocked characters, artwork, story images, and skills)

This demo is an early preview of the full experience.

We welcome all feedback from players—thank you for trying out Wicked Little Witch!

Thank you to every player brave enough to enter this forest.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains stylized depictions of romantic relationships, including light suggestive themes, kissing, and emotional conflict.
There is no explicit sexual content, no non-consensual acts, and no depictions of drug or alcohol use or self-harm.
